(type 'enemy'), and plays 'missile-hit'.
handleSubmit early-returns unless status === 'playing', inputLocked is false, and turn === 'player'.

On a matched answer, handleSubmit computes damage, calls submitAnswer, plays 'success', speaks the term via speechSynthesis, updates performance, logs 'You cast {term}!', applies damageEnemy, spawns enemy damage text, has a ~20% chance to schedule a 'CRITICAL!' text, increments turnsTaken, sets flashTone 'enemy', clears the input, and triggers the enemy turn only if the enemy survives.

On an unmatched answer, handleSubmit submits against the fallback action (the 'power' action or the first), plays 'error', records a miss in performance, logs 'Incorrect! The spell was {translation}.', clears the input, and triggers the enemy turn.

A page effect watches status: when status becomes 'victory' or 'defeat' it computes accuracy, computes base XP via calculateRpgBattleXp, scales it by the enemy multiplier, persists via handleGameComplete, and reveals the results screen after a 1200ms timeout; any non-terminal status hides results.

handleRestart resets all page-local states (input, turns, streak, flash/shake keys, flashTone 'enemy', results, XP, accuracy, performance), sets showStartScreen true and status 'idle', increments gameKey, and exits fullscreen.

Page constants: ACTION_COUNT = 3, BASIC_DAMAGE = 10, POWER_DAMAGE = 18, MAX_TURNS = 12 (page.tsx lines 49-52).

MAX_TURNS is referenced exactly twice in non-test source: its declaration (line 52) and as the maxTurns argument to calculateRpgBattleXp (line 289). No code enforces a turn limit that ends the battle.
Correct-answer damage = (power === 'power' ? POWER_DAMAGE : BASIC_DAMAGE) + Math.floor(streak / 2).
Post-damage enemy health is computed as Math.max(0, enemyHealth - damage) and the enemy counterattack fires only when that value is > 0.
scaleEnemyHealth(multiplier, baseHealth = BASE_ENEMY_HEALTH = 100) returns Math.round(baseHealth * multiplier).

Enemy damage rolls use BASE_ENEMY_DAMAGE_MIN = 6 and BASE_ENEMY_DAMAGE_MAX = 10: getEnemyDamageRange returns { min: 6, max: max(6, round(10 * multiplier)) } and rollEnemyDamage returns a uniform integer in that inclusive range.
battleEnemies defines four enemies with multipliers: slime 0.5, goblin 1, spectre 1.5, elemental 2 (rpgBattleSelection.ts lines 62-87).
battleHeroes defines two cosmetic heroes ('male', 'female') with 3x3 pose-sheet sprites, and battleLocations defines four backgrounds (forest-clearing, ruined-road, magic-arena, throne-hall).
calculateRpgBattleXp computes healthRatio (weight 0.6) + turnEfficiency (weight 0.4) + streakBoost (up to 0.2), maps the clamped score to round(1 + score * 9), and clamps the result to 1..10 XP.
Final XP = scaleBattleXp(baseXp, enemyMultiplier) = Math.round(baseXp * multiplier) (page.tsx lines 292-293; rpgBattleScaling.ts lines 16-18).

selectBattleActions weights each vocabulary word by MIN_WEIGHT (0.25) + difficulty, where difficulty = clamp(1 - accuracy, 0, 1); words with difficulty >= POWER_THRESHOLD (0.5) become 'power' actions; selection is weighted-random without replacement up to count (default 3).
The fallback for an unmatched typed answer is the action with power 'power', or actions[0] if none (page.tsx lines 369-370); the miss is recorded against that fallback term (line 417).
Answer matching is exact after trim + lowercase normalization of both the input and the expected translation (store submitAnswer lines 134-136; page handleSubmit lines 365-368).
Accuracy at battle end = totalCorrect / totalAttempts across the per-word performance map, or 0 when there were no attempts (page.tsx lines 223-231, 283).
turnsTaken is clamped to a minimum of 1 when sent to the completion API (line 247) and to the XP formula (line 288).
longestStreak tracks the maximum streak seen (page effect lines 214-216) and feeds the XP streakBoost; the live streak resets to 0 on any incorrect answer (store line 156).
ComboIndicator renders a 'COMBO x{streak}' badge only when streak >= 2 (ComboIndicator.tsx line 10).
A 'CRITICAL!' floating text is scheduled with probability Math.random() > 0.8 (~20%) 200ms after a correct hit (page.tsx lines 397-401); it does not alter damage.
On a correct answer the matched term is spoken via window.speechSynthesis with lang 'en-US' and rate 1.0, guarded by a browser-capability check (page.tsx lines 386-391).
There is no mana/MP system: grep -rni 'mana' over the rpg-battle components, page, store, and rpgBattle libs returns no non-test match at the baseline.
